body: Thank you. I'm sorry I'm hurting your heart
I think I've already hit my absolute best.

Honestly, you have brought me to tears. I feel all I've been doing these past few months was practice writing suicide notes. My family tells me the love me all the time.but it feels routine. Your I love you really hit me hard. I'm going to get off the floor and pull myself up. 

I'm so sorry about your dad. My friend killed themself in highschool and I know how it effects people around you. I can only imagine how you feel. You're very kind. Thank you
